main_text.l: eximiâ inuenitur in huiusmodi figurâ. Sic d. l. dicitur lô-
gitudo cœleftis Hierofolymæ esse 12000. stadiorum, lati-
tudo similiter 12000. stad. & altitudo totidem. Area ita-
que ipsius complectitur stadia 144000000. quæ multi-
plicata per stadia 12000. exhibent 1728000000000. cu-
bica stadia, è quibus singula sufficerent continendis ali-
cuius prouinciæ satis populosæ incolis. Unde intelligere
est, cœleftem Hierosolymam abundè sufficere ad exci-
piendum omnes omnino electos.
XIII. Praxis eorum, quæ hactenus sunt tra-
dita, continetur his aphorismis.
1. Architectus
sibi proponat schemata siue typos arcæ Noë, tabernaculi Mo-
sis, vrbis Hierusalem, templi Salomonis, tepli Ezechielis,
& cœleftis Hierosolymæ: prout figuræ istæ à doctissimis
viris sunt editæ, putà à Villalpando, Torniello, Lauate-
ro, & similibus. Proponat, inquam, sibi, & ichnogra-
phiam, den Grund / & orthographiam, den Aufriß.
2. Accurate obseruet proportiones, ornatum, amplitu-
dinem, & similia, prout in sacris literis describuntur.
3. Partes contentas & ornatum quoque diligenter obser-
uet, atque super istis rebus varias doctorum sententias
expendat. Sic v.g. 1. Reg. 6. v. 4. defeneftris templi legimus,
Salomonem illas fecisse [Hebrew]. Quidam vertunt,
prospectui accommodas, clausas, & priorem vocem interpre-
tantur, è lato contractas vtrinque vsque ad mediam cras-
sitiem muri, vt eâ ratione lux commodius vtrinque im-
mitteretur: posteriorem vocem ita explicant, vt dicant,
fuisse vitreas. Alij vertunt, apertas clausas, siue prospectuum
clauforum, i. e. laxiores intrinsecus, quàm extrinsecus, seu
latas intrinsecus, angustas extrinsecus. Sunt, qui reddunt,
obliquas, h. e. introrsum angustiores, extrorsum verò la-
tiores, vt multum lucis accipientes in templum inuehe-
rent. Alij verò feneftras intelligüt fa-ctas in modum retis,
hoc est, reticulatas, quales solent esse cancelli. Lutherus ad
hunc locum sic adnotat: Die Fenster so inwendig weit/

l.bl: vnnd außwendig enge sind / da kan man nicht wol noch

page.notes: The Hebrew phrase (1 Kings 6:4, "שְׁקֻפִים אֲטוּמִים") is printed in Hebrew letters and was transcribed as a placeholder only; the exact glyphs are not reliably legible at this scan resolution. The line numbers 5–35 in the left column are line markers, not text. The catchword "viel" and signature "L" are at the foot. The page numbering reads 161 at top right. Left-margin fragments from the adjacent page (e.g. "0.", "n-", "di") are edge of the neighbouring page and were omitted. The Hebrew and the German black-letter words are transcribed approximately.
